item.title: Dharmendra: What is He-Man and why only he deserved the title? | Dynamite News
item.description: Bollywood legend Dharmendra, fondly called He-Man, passed away at 89. Known for his strength, charisma, and action-packed roles, he earned a unique place in Indian cinema. “He-Man” signifies courage, power, and heroism, a title perfectly suited to Dharmendra due to his daring performances and screen presence.

item.title: Bureaucracy: 32 IAS officers in Uttar Pradesh set to retire starting January; Full list released | Dynamite News
item.description: Several IAS officers in Uttar Pradesh are set to receive permanent retirement next year. In fact, there are approximately 32 Indian Administrative Service officers in the state who are nearing retirement. The process of retirement for these officers will begin in January next year.

item.title: INS Mahe: India’s 900-tons, 77 meters indigenous ship showcases remarkable power | Dynamite News
item.description: When INS Mahe was commissioned into the Navy, General Upendra Dwivedi was present as the chief guest. He said on this occasion that it is not just a ship but a new strength of self-reliant India. Cochin Shipyard Limited has built it in India. Mahe is the first of a total of eight such ships being built.

item.title: These 5 foods are as dangerous for liver as alcohol; Leading to a fatty liver | Dynamite News
item.description: Sugary foods, drinks, high-fat and fried foods, and excessive red meat are harmful to the liver. These foods contribute to the accumulation of fat in the liver, increase inflammation, and damage the liver. They also contain refined carbohydrates and high salt, which are harmful to the liver.

item.title: Met Advani, fought elections… but Dharmendra never liked politics; Here’s why | Dynamite News
item.description: The legendary star passed away on Monday. His last rites were performed at the Vile Parle crematorium in Mumbai. Dharmendra earned a special place in the hearts of audiences through his powerful acting. He also dabbled in politics. After meeting former Indian Deputy Prime Minister L.K. Advani, he decided to enter politics. However, he soon became disillusioned with politics.
